summary: LATE-SLATE BET NOW: Justin Herbert Over 19.5 rushing yards at DraftKings -109. Covers' current LV-LAC prop board captured at the 13:32 ET mini-slate refresh lists DK O19.5 -109, FanDuel O19.5 -113, BetRivers O19.5 -115, and Fanatics O20.5 -105; Covers projects 30.5 rushing yards and its analyst independently recommends O20.5, noting Herbert ran for 29 yards on five carries in Week 1 and has cleared 20.5 in five of his last six outings. PRIME uses a conservative 60% fair Over probability rather than transferring Covers' projection directly, producing an estimated 7.85 percentage-point edge versus -109. Play-to is 20.5 at -115 or better; do not chase 21.5+. Ladd McConkey remains officially questionable; NFL Network reports optimism he can play barring a setback. This bet does not require McConkey to be inactive. Official late-window inactives have not yet populated on NFL.com's inactive page, so all other role-dependent late props remain pending. Existing Jeanty 50+ rushing and Purdy 16+ completions parlay legs remain HOLD; Taylor 15+ receiving remains scheduled for SNF recheck. No new Grok pass.
